explanation.headline: FDA's records show multiple manufacturers on the shortage list since 2023-02-15; the Hikma plant in Portugal was classified VAI 12 days before the posting and again 65 days after; the Hospira plant in the US had OAI classifications in 2010 and 2011 with warning letters in 2010 and 2014

sentences.text: FDA first posted the rocuronium bromide shortage on 2023-02-15 and as of 2026-10-21 it has been on the list for 44 months.

The shortage list includes Baxter Healthcare, Eugia US LLC, Fresenius Kabi USA LLC, Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc., Hospira Inc., Meitheal Pharmaceuticals Inc., Mylan Institutional, Piramal Critical Care Inc., Sagent Pharmaceuticals, Sandoz Inc., and XGen Pharmaceuticals DJB Inc., all with Current status.
FDA inspection 1254066 at the Hikma Farmaceutica (Portugal) S.A. plant ended 2023-02-03 and was classified VAI, 12 days before the shortage posting.
FDA inspection 1203129 at the same Hikma plant ended 2023-04-21 and was classified VAI, 65 days after the shortage posting.
The Hospira Inc. plant (FEI 1021343) received OAI classifications after inspections ending 2010-01-19 and 2011-06-17, with a warning letter issued 2010-04-12.
A second Hospira inspection ending 2011-08-04 was also classified OAI, and a warning letter was issued to Hikma Farmaceutica (Portugal) S.A. on 2014-10-21.

The rule-based transfer option ranked 1 moves 13 units from Corvale Lakeside (29 days on hand) to Corvale East (8.3 days on hand, reaching 9 days), which requires a pharmacy director transfer request.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Q-c1462a.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%rocuronium%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%rocuronium%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-40dc91.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('d3a172a5-01ab-47d8-92ac-a8539b1d4dc4', '309aeb1b-8022-4df7-8194-ae6529e3395c', '15897860-d6a9-07e5-e063-6394a90aec75') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-7b4fed.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%rocuronium%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-ad5f1f.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%rocuronium%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-3e99f5.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%rocuronium%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%inject%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-d5b84c.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('3005564767', '1021343', '3002807173', '3008461619', '3001833549', '3000280991', '3009864167', '3010625707', '3000280957') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-d6b742.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('3005564767', '1021343', '3002807173', '3008461619', '3001833549', '3000280991', '3009864167', '3010625707', '3000280957') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-ac47b4.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('3005564767', '1021343', '3002807173') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('hospira worldwide', 'hospira', 'hikma farmaceutica s a')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-abda0a.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('hospira worldwide', 'hospira', 'hikma farmaceutica s a', 'hikma', 'hf acquisition dba healthfirst') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%rocuronium%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-16e162.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, end_date, cfr, short_description FROM fda.citations WHERE inspection_id IN ('639034', '732886', '740633', '876911') ORDER BY inspection_id, cfr
